stage_name: D3.5-A5-R2 — Repaired Selectivity Prototype Freeze & Revalidation
document_type: repaired-policy preregistration (frozen before any real-case repaired outcome)

fixture_extension_identity.scope: additive only: object_type + full frozen locator on eligible candidate entries and payload-registry entries, read mechanically from the frozen normalized corpus so the complete-universe evaluator can run the frozen GoldEvidenceSelector matching; all pre-existing fields verified identical; no gold labels, case roles, or manual annotations added
fixture_extension_identity.preservation_verified: candidate universe/IDs/orderings/payload text/source-version identity/provenance origins/A2 replay equivalence unchanged

rank_order: 2. rarity_weighted_overlap DESC (idf(t) = log2((|U|+1)/(df(t)+1)), base 2, universe-local df)
4. text_presence DESC (distinct normal query tokens in tokenized text[:2000])
5. support_rank ASC (missing worse than any present, never disqualifying)
hard_filters: MIN_PRIMARY_SCORE >= 1 on the unchanged v1 path/title lexical gate
exact_frozen_rank_contract_reference.symbol_contract: NFKC -> casefold -> path separators '/'; compound identifier never split; boundary-aware matching with [a-z0-9_] identifier class; underscore preserved; no hyphen/camelCase equivalence; surfaces = basename/path/text[:2000]; title excluded; distinct-symbol counting; empty plan.symbols -> 0
exact_frozen_rank_contract_reference.df_definition: unique eligible candidate object IDs in U whose candidate_lexical_view (deduplicated union of basename/parent-directory/title/text[:2000] tokens) contains t; U = universe after source/scope eligibility

selection_subset_invariant: selected ⊆ gate-passing eligible governed candidates ⊆ complete eligible governed universe
attribution: least-used-origin (tie: lexicographically smallest origin id); attributed-origin ceiling semantics; membership counts reported separately

decision_rule.scientific_question: Does the single preregistered repaired deterministic relevance policy preserve the bounded fan-out behavior established by A5 while retaining all applicable required bridge evidence that reaches the unchanged relevance gate?
decision_rule.not_asked: does final answer retrieval recover? (no reranker/selector involved)

requires_all: determinism passes (byte-identical double execution per case)
high-fan-out behavior remains bounded by the frozen caps
no GATE_RECALL_LIMITATION for designated required bridge evidence
all required bridge evidence present in the complete eligible universe AND passing the unchanged hard gate is retained by v2 (no APPLICABLE_AND_LOST)
PASS / REPAIRED_SELECTIVITY_RELEVANCE_RE.meaning: development/mechanistic validation only; not end-to-end retrieval validation

decision_rule.PARTIAL / GATE_RECALL_LIMITATION_OBSERVE: ranking retention succeeds for all gate-passing applicable evidence but one or more required candidates found in the complete eligible universe are rejected by the unchanged hard gate; A6 remains NOT_READY; gate not modified
decision_rule.PARTIAL / REPAIRED_RANKING_STILL_LOSES_R: fan-out remains bounded but one or more applicable gate-passing required candidates are APPLICABLE_AND_LOST; A6 remains NOT_READY
decision_rule.FAIL / REPAIRED_SELECTIVITY_NOT_USEFUL: fan-out control materially breaks, controls expand unexpectedly, determinism fails, relevance retention substantially worsens, or governance/scope invariants fail
decision_rule.INVALID: real-case outcomes inspected before freeze, more than one unregistered repaired policy evaluated, policy contract changed after outcome exposure, fixture/evaluator changed outcome-dependently, or expected evidence leaked into the scorer
decision_rule.g021_group_semantics: a required-evidence group is classified over its universe-matched candidates (any_of semantics): NOT_APPLICABLE if none in universe; GATE_RECALL_LIMITATION if matched candidates exist but all are gate-rejected; APPLICABLE_AND_RETAINED if at least one gate-passing matched candidate is selected; APPLICABLE_AND_LOST if gate-passing matched candidates exist but none selected

evaluator_contract.universe: complete pre-cap eligible governed candidate universe
evaluator_contract.flow: fixture -> v2 selectivity -> selected candidates frozen -> evaluator-only selector matching -> applicability classification
evaluator_contract.newly_visible_discovery: required-evidence candidates matched in the complete universe that A2's combined-pool provenance never saw are reported as NEWLY_VISIBLE_COMPLETE_UNIVERSE_APPLICABLE_EVIDENCE

prohibited_actions: change the R1/R1-R1 design, caps, or hard gate
try alternative scorers or run a second repaired policy
